description: TIER 2 IMPLEMENTATION: Continue fine-tuning from run a6a86fd6 (22.85 dB) dengan IMPROVED CONFIG. Key improvements: (1) LR scheduling enabled, (2) Lower LR for stability, (3) Tighter early stopping, (4) SSIM loss added. Target: 24-26 dB PSNR (+2-3 dB gain).

baseline_issues: No LR scheduling → late-stage instability (std 0.50 dB)
LR 0.00005 constant → no adaptation to training phase
Patience 12 too loose → saved suboptimal model (epoch 49 vs 18)
Converged epoch 18 but continued to 50 → overfitting
tier2_improvements: LR scheduling: Cosine decay 0.00003 → 0.0000003 over 25 epochs
Lower LR: 0.00003 (vs 0.00005) → 40% reduction for fine-tuning stability
Tighter early stopping: patience 8 (vs 12), captures optimal model earlier
30 epochs (vs 50): prevent overfitting, focus on optimal convergence zone
Warmup 3 epochs: smooth transition from pretrained weights
Same loss weights as successful baseline (pixel=200, perceptual=10)
experiment_metadata.training_strategy: Continue from best checkpoint (epoch 49, 22.85 dB) with improved hyperparameters for +2-3 dB gain

expected_outcome.stability: Lower LR + scheduling → std dev <0.20 dB (vs 0.50)
expected_outcome.best_epoch: Earlier optimal capture via tighter early stopping
